Two looks in one! This reversible gingham duvet cover set features a classic check pattern on one side and a solid color on the other, so you can switch up your bedroom style in seconds. Create a cozy dining nook with this minimalist round tulip dining table. Smooth sealed melamine finish prevents liquid penetration. Food residue, coffee spills and dust can be quickly wiped away with a damp cloth, no complicated cleaning required. Rounded table edges avoid bumps and offer safer daily use.
